What setup will do

  • Copy Cog to «tmp»/002/cog/bin/cog.
  • Keep settings in «tmp»/002/cog/cog.toml and data in «tmp»/002/cog.
  • Make admin an admin, with the password you chose.
  • Start Cog now and whenever you sign in.
  • Make a certificate for 192.168.1.20, homebox, homebox.local, localhost, 127.0.0.1.

The first visit from each device

Browsers warn that the certificate is not trusted, because Cog signed it itself. When setup finishes it shows the certificate's fingerprint: check that the browser shows the same one (in the warning's details), then continue. Apps such as the Nextcloud client ask the same question once.
